To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SPM system can reduce the cultivation loss by 32%, and the tension force can be reduced to 0.5 N by moving the conjunction point to the bottom ring.
the SPM fish cages with different deformation suppression methods can reduce the volume loss of cultivation by 32%.
all the three deformation suppression measures can reduce the cultivation loss at least by one-third.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the deformation suppression of a single point mooring fish cages.
the numerical simulation of the SPM system under different deformation suppression methods.
the numerical study of the SPM gravity fish cage with different deformation suppression methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SPM system can be improved by adding the lower bridling, moving the conjunction points close to the bottom rings, and adding the frontal rigid frames.

the SPM fish cages with different deformation suppression methods can effectively reduce the cultivation volume lost caused by deformation, and the SPM system can be a promising alternative to the multi point fish cages.

the deformation suppression methods have positive effects in reducing the cultivation volume loss, and the trawl door method can be the best choice in the three methods for the SPM gravity fish cage system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the SPM fish cages can be designed with the three deformation suppression method and the conjunction point can be placed at a proper position to reduce the cultivation loss and the tension force simultaneously.
, the three methods can be used in combination to further reduce the cultivation volume lost and increase the fish survival rate.
, in order to reduce the cultivation loss, the SPM system should be equipped with the deformation suppression methods, especially under the combined wave current conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, for the Norwegian fish cage, the SPM fish cages with the lower bridles or the frontal rigid frame can be a better option than the one with the trawl door in the case of the current velocity is smaller than 1.5 m/s, and the one with the lower bridled SPM system is more preferable when the current velocity exceeds 1.5m/s.
the SPM fish cages can be improved with the addition of deformation suppression methods.
the SPM system is a promising alternative to the multi-point mooring fish cages, especially for the large scale fish cages.
